title: Fresh native intent correlation, unique module and pull adapter handoff
statement: The audited P1 (settled allowed reply authorising a later same-command intent) is reproduced, fixed and covered by independent negatives. A production pull adapter absorbs the current B route needs. B already imports this module at the wave-27 blob and still needs to merge the wave-28 delta and adopt the adapter; H has not executed the current source in its own tree.

p1.redTest: apps/runner/test/attach-channel/fresh-intent.test.ts (3 failures before the fix: reused frame.id and replay accepted)
p1.rootCause: pending native writes were keyed by command.id, so frame.id equalled the business id and a settled reply matched a later pending intent
fix: each beforeNativeWrite allocates intent-<module salt>-<n>; frame.id is that correlation while command id/body/attempt/native binding stay byte-for-byte
pending writes keyed by the intent correlation; settlement removes the correlation permanently
concurrent second intent for one business command refused with protocol_error/write_already_pending
NativeWriteDenied still reports the original business command id
no new wire version, contracts change or ledger: the local v1 schema already separates frame.id from command
negatives: replayed allowed frame for a settled intent returns false and leaves the later intent pending
replayed denial cannot decide a later intent either
intent correlation ids are unique across calls and modules
timed-out and closed intents cannot be revived by a late allowed frame
intent ids never appear as the business command id
